title: spec: `ImportJobStatus` and `ImportJobProgressSchema.error` docblocks say `failed` is only a fatal abort; after #27676 B an all-rows-failed job also ends `failed`
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Blocked-by: #27676

The spec half of the maintainer's ruling on #27676 (letter **B**, record `6509036166`, execution parameter 5). The server half changes the async import job's terminal status on #27676 itself; this card is its own `domain:spec` PR, as the ruling directs.

## What to change

`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`:

- `ImportJobStatus`: `'succeeded'` is commented "Finished (rows may still have per-row errors)" and `'failed'` "Aborted on a fatal error". After #27676, `failed` also covers a job with at least one row in which no row was created, updated or skipped. `succeeded` still covers a zero-row job, an all-skipped job and a partly-failed job.
- `ImportJobProgressSchema.error` is described as "Fatal error message (when status = failed)". It is now also set, with one sentence pointing at `results`, when every row failed.

Then `gen:docs`. No enum value, key or type changes: the wire is unchanged; only the declared meaning of `failed` is widened to the ruled case.

Land after the #27676 server PR merges, so the declaration never describes behaviour `main` does not have.

Filed with `domain:spec` as the ruling directs; grading is triage's.
